title: KV heap pruning, page-trim scheduler and delayed async spillback
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Improved KV memory compaction and eviction stability: introduces heap pruning pass, page-trim scheduler, and a delayed async spillback to reduce fragmentation and tail-latency under mixed workloads.
description: Motivation: tenant workloads with high prefix reuse were suffering from poor memory locality and fragmented slab pages which increased per-request tail latency and spikey GC/eviction behavior. This PR introduces a coordinated set of runtime changes: (1) a conservative heap_pruner that merges short-lived fragment lists and trims underutilized page segments, (2) a page-trim scheduler that runs low-impact compaction windows respecting SLOs, and (3) a delayed async_spillback mechanism that batches remote spill operations to avoid synchronous backpressure. The changes are intended to reduce sustained fragmentation, smooth outbound spill bursts, and keep critical inference paths within latency SLOs. Changes include runtime algorithms, instrumentation, unit + integration tests, and operational docs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in ENG ticket ENG-4821 - [x] Unit tests covering pruner heuristics - [x] Integration test with continuous-batching workload harness - [x] Benchmarks showing 12-18% P95 latency reduction on mixed small/long sequences - [x] Docs for ops tuning and new knobs - [ ] Follow-up: tenant-level throttle UI (ENG-4980). Related: SUP-1342 investigates customer incident where spill storms caused request degradation.

operational_impact: New knobs: kv.pruner.enabled (bool), kv.pruner.budget_pct (0-100), kv.page_trim.window_ms, kv.spillback.batch_size, kv.spillback.delay_ms. Default settings are conservative and backwards compatible; operator documentation added in docs/ops/kv-memory-tuning.md.
rollback_plan: Disable kv.pruner.enabled or set page_trim.window_ms=0 to revert compaction windows. Async spillback can be set to immediate mode by setting kv.spillback.delay_ms=0 to restore previous behavior.
notes: This PR focuses on low-risk, staged rollout; changes gated by config flags and guarded by SLO-aware scheduler. Ops team to monitor eviction_telemetry.eviction_rate and kv.fragmentation_ratio for 72 hours post rollout.
